_about: DRAFT evaluation set for the ICOS MCP server (docs/icos-mcp-plan.md, Quality 3). Written 2026-10-30 from the catalogue and the station lists as served; TO BE REVIEWED by one person per domain (atmosphere, ocean, ecosystem) before it is relied on. Each question names what a CORRECT answer must use (expect: an acceptable variable id, station, QC choice) and a TRUTH a grader computes from the proxy itself at run time (truth.query is a /query or /summary request, truth.stat what to compute from it), so the set does not go stale as the data grow. 'probes' says which trap the question exists to catch.

questions.question: What was the mean CO2 mole fraction at Hyltemossa (150 m) in January 2025?
questions.probes: name -> station id (find_stations), the default intake height

questions.question: How much methane was measured at Norunda in 2024? Give the annual mean at the highest inlet.
questions.probes: 'methane' -> ch4 (synonym), highest of several intake heights (NOR100)

questions.question: Which ICOS atmosphere stations within 250 km of Hamburg measure CH4?
questions.probes: find_stations near a point; distinct stations vs intake heights

questions.question: Compare nitrous oxide at Jungfraujoch and Izana in 2024: which is higher on average?
questions.probes: 'nitrous oxide' -> n2o; two mountain stations in one request (JFJ13, IZO29)

questions.question: Using only quality-controlled data, what is the hourly CO2 range at Karlsruhe 200 m in July 2024?
questions.probes: apply_qc on a string flag (O/U kept, N/K dropped)

questions.question: Is there radon data at Cabauw, and from which inlet?
questions.probes: radon -> rn; coverage, not a value

questions.question: What was the air temperature at the Hyltemossa tower top on 1 July 2025 at noon UTC?
questions.probes: meteorology in the obspack store (mto.at), a single timestamp

questions.question: How many ICOS atmosphere station records (station and height) report CO in 2025?
questions.probes: 'CO' not CO2; summary not data

questions.question: Give me the CO2 data for Svartberget 150 m for the whole of 2023 as a file I can load in pandas.
questions.probes: a selection too large for get_data: the answer must give download_url, not paste rows

questions.question: How should I cite ICOS atmospheric CO2 data?
questions.probes: get_citation; the collection DOI

questions.question: What was the annual net ecosystem exchange at Hyltemossa (SE-Htm) in 2023, in gC m-2 y-1?
questions.probes: the yearly panel and its unit; NEE_VUT_REF not a cube slice

questions.question: Which month of 2022 had the highest gross primary production at Hyytiala?
questions.probes: 'gross primary production' -> GPP, monthly panel, FI-Hyy

questions.question: List the ICOS ecosystem flux sites in Finland.
questions.probes: find_stations by country on a fluxnet panel

questions.question: What was the total precipitation at Hainich in 2021?
questions.probes: precipitation -> P_F; a sum over daily values, mm

questions.question: What is the latest net ecosystem exchange measured at Brasschaat this week?
questions.probes: 'latest' -> the near-real-time store, not the release

questions.question: Using only good-quality half-hours, what was the mean latent heat flux at Brasschaat in the last month of NRT data?
questions.probes: apply_qc on the Foken SSITC flag (keep <= 1)

questions.question: Which ecosystem stations north of 60 degrees have near-real-time air temperature?
questions.probes: find_stations by box on the eco-nrt meteo panel

questions.question: What was the daily ecosystem respiration at Hyytiala on 15 July 2022?
questions.probes: respiration -> RECO, daily panel, partitioning choice stated

questions.question: Was Hyltemossa a carbon sink or source in 2023?
questions.probes: sign convention of NEE (negative = uptake), yearly value

questions.question: How do I cite the near-real-time flux data from Hyltemossa?
questions.probes: NRT has no collection DOI: the per-object citation from the passport

questions.question: How many surface-ocean CO2 observations are there in the Baltic Sea in 2023? Use the box 53-66 N, 9-30 E.
questions.probes: obs table, a bounding box given in the question (no stations), estimate/summary or aggregate

questions.question: What was the mean fCO2 in the North Sea in summer 2022 (June to August), good data only? Use the box 51-61 N, 4 W - 9 E.
questions.probes: WOCE flag 2 = good (apply_qc), box, a mean over many cruises

questions.question: How many 1x1 degree grid cells of the gridded monthly SOCAT fCO2 product have data in the North Atlantic box 30-65 N, 60 W - 0 E in 2020?
questions.probes: the gridded product (socat-gridded), not the observations

questions.question: Which ICOS ocean stations are there?
questions.probes: find_stations refuses an obs table; the agent must explain and use the ICOS ocean store's platforms instead

questions.question: What is the sea surface temperature range in the ICOS ocean data around Iceland in 2024?
questions.probes: Temp in the ocean store is WATER temperature (not air); box

questions.question: How should I cite the SOCAT data?
questions.probes: get_citation on the SOCAT synthesis (a different collection from ICOS ocean)

questions.question: What greenhouse-gas data does ICOS offer?
questions.probes: list_datasets, three domains, no fetching

questions.question: Is there any data at a station called Nowhere?
questions.probes: a station that does not exist: say so, do not invent one

questions.question: Give me CO2 at Hyltemossa in 1990.
questions.probes: a period before the record starts: an empty selection reported as such

questions.question: What is the CO2 standard deviation at Hyltemossa 150 m in January 2025?
questions.probes: asking FOR a companion (std_dev) must find it, not the primary (queryable since the 2026-10-30 catalogue fix; before it, 67 of 78 icos-obspack ids answered 501)
